left.raw_text: - Patients older than 18 years (of both sexes) diagnosed with rheumatoid arthritis according to ACR / EULAR 2010 criteria.
- Patients with moderate to high disease activity (DAS - 28. score greater than 3.2)

right.raw_text: - Patients received the standard therapy (i.e. one or more conventional DMARDs) for at least three months.
